question.problem:
Consider the matrices given below. Find $\,\text{dim(Null}(A))+\text{dim(Null}(B))+\text{dim(Null}(C)).$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ 0 & -4\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 8 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}2 & 7 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
The dimension of the null space of a matrix is the number of non-pivot columns in the matrix. 

Also, all of the given matrices are in row echelon form.

With that in mind, let's consider each of the statements.

- The matrix $A$ has $2$ pivot columns and no non-pivot column. So, 

$$
\text{dim(Null}(A))=0.
$$

- The matrix $B$ has $2$ pivot columns and $1$ non-pivot column (namely, the $3$rd column). So, 

$$
\text{dim(Null}(B))=1.
$$

- The matrix $C$ has $1$ pivot column and $2$ non-pivot columns (namely, the $2$nd and $3$rd columns). So, 

$$
\text{dim(Null}(C))=2.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\text{dim(Null}(A))+\text{dim(Null}(B))+\text{dim(Null}(C))=0+1+2=3.
$$
